ok = r.set_gripper_aperture({"aperture_m": 0.02})
print("set_gripper_aperture(0.02):", ok, r._piper_gripper_pos())

print("set_gripper_aperture(0.0):", ok, r._piper_gripper_pos())
ok = r.set_gripper_aperture({"aperture_m": 0.035})
print("set_gripper_aperture(0.035):", ok, r._piper_gripper_pos())

# 3. move_end_effector_with_wrist
r.home(duration=1.5)
ok = r.move_end_effector_with_wrist({"target_xyz": [0.25, 0.0, 0.25], "wrist_roll_rad": 0.5})
print("move_end_effector_with_wrist:", ok, "j6:", r._piper_joint6_pos())

# 4. apply_contact_displacement
r.home(duration=1.5)
ok = r.apply_contact_displacement({
    "contact_xyz": [0.25, 0.0, 0.25],
    "terminal_xyz": [0.25, 0.1, 0.25],
})
print("apply_contact_displacement:", ok, r._piper_ee_pos())

# 5. move_end_effector_via_waypoint
r.home(duration=1.5)
ok = r.move_end_effector_via_waypoint({
    "waypoint_xyz": [0.25, 0.0, 0.35],
    "final_xyz": [0.25, 0.1, 0.25],
})
print("move_end_effector_via_waypoint:", ok, r._piper_ee_pos())

# 6. Failure cases

ok_fail = r.move_end_effector({"target_xyz": [5.0, 5.0, 5.0]})
print("move_end_effector (unreachable):", ok_fail)

ok_clamp = r.set_gripper_aperture({"aperture_m": 0.1})
print("set_gripper_aperture (clamped):", ok_clamp)

print("move_end_effector_with_wrist (bad wrist):", ok_wrist_fail)

print("=== ALL DONE ===")
EOF
